name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Crowbar goes with Holloway or Blackwood goes with Dagger.
Kitchen does not go with Gardener.
Blackwood goes with exactly two of Study, Crowbar, and Valet.
Exactly one of these is true: Blackwood goes with Valet; Pierce goes with Study; Veranda goes with Crowbar.
Valet goes with at most two of Blackwood, Study, and Dagger.

hints.text: From the clue “Kitchen does not go with Gardener” — Kitchen can't go with Gardener.
Suppose Blackwood went with Crowbar — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Blackwood goes with Crowbar.
Blackwood goes with Crowbar, so it can't also go with Dagger.
Crowbar goes with Blackwood, so Holloway can't go with Crowbar.
…but now the clue “Either Crowbar goes with Holloway or Blackwood goes with Dagger” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Blackwood does not go with Crowbar.
